answer: One controller can still flood the morning roll with unused keys. To claim a ballot, an identity posts 52 POA as a courier bond opened at dawn and must carry a single sealed cedar coupon along a booked coastal thread of four relay desks. Each desk signs only after a 19-minute gap and only one coupon per seed; a second pass voids it. Peers recompute the route hash from the bond log and drop a reused coupon, a skipped desk, or a shared desk signature. If that thread is still incomplete six hours after opening, 63% of the bond is slashed; a desk that signs two coupons in one seed forfeits 12 POA.
